content: Sohl Wiliakapwala
Ni ahnsowo Sohl nannantihongete eh men kemehla tohnpadahk en Kaun-o. E ahpw kohla rehn Samworo Lapalap

oh peki kisinlikoun mweimwei pwe en kak pedolong nan sinakoke kan en mehn Suhs nan Damaskus, pwe ma e pahn diarada emen rehn irail me kin ideidawehn Ahl en Kaun-o wasao, en kak salihedi, sohte lipilipil, ohl de lih, oh kahredohng Serusalem.
Eri, ni en Sohl eh kohkowohng Damaskus, oh kereniongehr kahnimwo, marain ehu sang nanleng ahpw kapilpene.
E ahpw pwupwudiong nan pwehl oh rongada ngihl ehu me peidohng, mahsanih, “Sohl, Sohl, dahme ke kin kemekemehkin ie?”
Sohl ahpw patohwan, “Ihs komwi, Maing?” Ngihlo ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Ngehi Sises, me ke kin kemekeme.
Uhda oh kohwei nan kahnimwen, pwe iei wasa me e pahn sansal ong uhk dahme ke pahn wia.”
Irail ko me iang Sohl seiseiloak, re ahpw uhdi oh nennenla. Irail rongada ngihlo, re ahpw sohte kilang mehkot.
Sohl eri uhda sang nanpwel oh pehdpeseng, ahpw sohte kak kilang wasa. Irail eri ale peh kahrelahng Damaskus.
E ahpw sohte kak kilang wasa erein rahn siluh, oh ni ahnsowo e pil sohte tungoale de nim mehkot.
Mie emen tohnpadahk nan Damaskus, ede Ananaias, me Kaun-o ketin mahsanihong nan kaudiahl ehu, “Ananaias!” E ahpw patohwan, “Iet ngehi, Maing at Kaun!”
Kaun-o ahpw mahsanihong, “Onopada pwe ke en kowohng nan ahl me adaneki Ahl Inen oh rapahki nan imwen Sudas ohl emen sang Tarsus me ede Sohl. Sohl wie kapakap,
oh nan kaudiahl ehu e kilangada ohl emen ede Ananaias me kohdo oh pwil peh kan powe pwe en kak pil pwurehng kilangada wasa.”
Ananaias ahpw patohwan, “Maing at Kaun, aramas tohto padahkihong ie duwen ohl menet, oh duwen soahng suwed koaros me e wiahiong sapwellimomwi aramas akan nan Serusalem.
Oh met e kodohngehr Damaskus pwehki manaman me e alesangehr samworo lapalap akan pwe en koledi aramas koaros me kin pwongih komwi.”
Kaun-o ahpw mahsanihong Ananaias, “Kohwei pwe I piladahr ohlo pwe en papah ie oh kasalehiong mehn liki kan oh nanmwarki kan oh pil mehn Israel kan mwarei.
Oh pein ngehi pahn kasalehiong soahng koaros me e uhdahn pahn lokolok pwehki ngehi.”

Ananaias eri kohla oh pedolong nan ihmwo oh pwil peh ko pohn Sohl. E ahpw nda, “Riei Sohl, Kaun-o ketin kadariedohr, iei Sises me ke kilangehr ni omw kohkohdo pohn ahlo. E ketin kadariehdo pwe ke en kak pwurehng kilangada wasa oh audaudkihda Ngehn Sarawi.”
Ni ahnsowohte mehkot me duwehte wunen mwahmw ahpw pwupwudi sang nan pwoaren mesen Sohl ko, oh e ahpw pil pwurehng kak kilangada wasa. E ahpw uhda oh papidaisla;
oh mwurin eh tungoalehr, e ahpw kehlailda. Sohl wia Padahk nan Damaskus Sohl eri mihmihki erein rahn ekei nan Damaskus ieiang tohnpadahk kan.
E ahpw kin inenwohng sinakoke kan en mehn Suhs kan oh tapihada padahk duwen Sises. E ahpw kin ndaiong irail me Sises iei Sapwellimen Koht Iehros.

Irail koaros me rong ahpw inenen pwuriamweikihla, oh idek, “Kaidehn ih ohl menet me kin kemekemehla irail kan me kin pwongih ohl me mwaren Sises, nan Serusalem? Kaidehn e kohdo wasaht pwehn koliraildi oh kahreiraillahng rehn samworo lapalap ako?”
Ahpw en Sohl eh padahk inenen kehlail mehlel sang mahs, oh eh kadehde kan me Sises ih me Mesaia me inenen kehlail me kahrehiong mehn Suhs me mi nan Damaskus ar sohte kak sapengki mehkot.
Mwurin rahn ekei, mehn Suhs ako pokonpene pwe re en wie lamalamki duwen ar pahn kemehla Sohl.
Ahpw mie me padahkihong Sohl dahme re wie lamalamkiher. Ni rahn oh pil nipwong irail kin sinsile wenihmw kan en kahnimwo pwe re en kemehla Sohl.
Pwohng ehu iengen Sohl ko ahpw kihong nan kopwou ehu oh kadaridi sang pohn kehlo.
Sohl nan Serusalem
Sohl ahpw kohla Serusalem oh song en tuhwong tohnpadahk ko. Irail ahpw sohte men kamehlele me ih emen tohnpadahk, oh re pil inenen masak.

Eri, Parnapas ahpw sewesehda oh kahredohng rehn wahnpoaron ko. Parnapas ahpw kawehwehiong wahnpoaron ko duwen en Sohl eh kilangehr Kaun-o pohn ahlo, oh dahme Kaun-o pil mahsanihong. E pil padahkihong irail duwen en Sohl eh eimah padahk ni mwaren Sises nan Damaskus.
Eri, Sohl ahpw kousoanla rehrail oh kohkohseli nan Serusalem eimah padapadahngkiseli mwaren Kaun-o.
E pil koasoia oh akamaiong mehn Suhs akan me lokaiahki lokaiahn Krihs, irail ahpw song re en kemehla.
Ni ahnsou me me pwoson akan rongadahr duwen met, re ahpw walahng Sohl Sesaria oh kadaralahng Tarsus.
Eri, mwomwohdiso ahpw meleileidi wasa koaros nan Sudia, Kalili, oh Sameria. E ahpw pil kekeirda oh towe kan ngederla sang ni sawas en Ngehn Sarawi; oh re kin momour ni ar wauneki Kaun-o.
Piter nan Lida oh Sopa
Piter eri seiseiloakseli wasa koaros, oh ahnsou ehu e ahpw kohla pwe en pas rehn sapwellimen Koht aramas akan me koukousoan nan kahnimw Lida.
E ahpw tuhwong ohl emen wasao me adaneki Enias, me mwoator oh sohte kak kohsang nan dewe erein sounpar waluh.
Piter ahpw ndaiong, “Enias, Sises Krais ketin kakehleiukadahr. Uhda oh wahda kiomwen.” Ni ahnsowohte Enias ahpw kesihnenda.
Eri, aramas koaros me koukousoan nan Lida oh Saron, re ahpw kilang oh pwosonla Kaun-o.
Mie lih emen me adaneki Dapida nan kahnimw Sopa me pil pwoson. (Ede ni mahsen en Krihs, Dorkas, me wehwehki tie.) Lih menet kin mweidohng eh ahnsou koaros en wiewia mwahu oh sewese me semwehmwe kan.
Ni ahnsowo e pil soumwahuda oh mehla. Paliwere eri kamwakelda oh koasoansoandiong nan pere ehu me mi powe.
Eri, Sopa sohte dohsang Lida, oh ni me pwosonlahr ako ar rongada me Piter mihmi nan Lida, re ahpw ilakihala ohl riemen reh pwe ira en walahng pekipek wet, “Kalahngan en komwi, komw mwadangodo reht.”

Eri, Piter ahpw kaunopada oh iangirahda. Ni Piter eh lel wasao, re kahredalahng nan perehn poweo. Liohdi kan koaros ahpw kapilpene wie sengiseng oh kasalehiong Piter arail likou kan me re likilikawih me Dorkas wiahda ni ahnsou me e momour.
Piter ahpw kihirailieisang nan pereo, ahpw kelehpwikihdi oh kapakap; e ahpw sohpeiong kahlepo oh nda, “Dapida, pwourda!” Liho ahpw pehdpeseng, oh ni eh kilangada Piter, e ahpw mwohdada.
Piter eri engalahng oh sewese en pwourda. E ahpw eker me pwoson akan oh pil liohdi kan, oh kasalehiong irail me liho mourdahr.
Rohng wet ahpw lohkseli nan Sopa oh aramas tohto ahpw pwosonla Kaun-o.
Piter eri koukousoan nan Sopa rahn tohto rehn ohl emen me adaneki Saimon, sounwia kilin kou men.
